description: OpenCode++: a Coding Agent Reliability Harness for OpenCode, adding context, edit boundaries, command evidence, verification gates, impact analysis, and repair loops.OpenCode++：面向 OpenCode 的 AI 编程可靠性增强框架，为其增加上下文管理、编辑边界、命令证据、验证门禁、影响分析与修复闭环能力。
